Hiro Moreau started Halcyon Labs in 1997 after leaving university

questions.question: Who founded the company that makes the Lattice router?

supports.contains: Marrow Labs makes the Lattice router
Dario Ueda started Marrow Labs in 2010 after leaving university

questions.question: Who founded the company that makes the Pioneer scale?

supports.contains: Kestrel Labs designs and sells the Pioneer scale
Kestrel Labs was founded by Felix Gallo in 2001

questions.question: Who founded the company that makes the Quill editor?

supports.contains: Halcyon Analytics makes the Quill editor
Halcyon Analytics was founded by Esther Kapoor in 1990

questions.question: Who founded the company that makes the Tidal pump?

supports.contains: Meridian Labs makes the Tidal pump
Lars Haddad started Meridian Labs in 2001 after leaving university
